name: MotherCare Baby Shampoo 300ml
description:
Product Name: MotherCare All We Know Baby Shampoo
Volume: 300ml
Suitable For: From birth

Key Features

Dermatologically Tested & Hypoallergenic: Gentle and safe for newborns

Tear-Free Formula: Ensures a comfortable and happy bath time

PH Balanced: Gentle on the scalp and hair

Natural Extracts: Enriched with Olive Oil (ultimate moisturizer) and Chamomile (soothing properties)

Free From Harmful Chemicals: No parabens, phthalates, or formaldehyde

100% Vegetarian: Safe and natural for babies

Benefits

Cleanses the scalp gently while conditioning hair

Leaves baby’s hair soft, shiny, and naturally clean

Soothes and nourishes delicate baby skin
